subject.title: [Bug]: keyless WebIQ search disables secrets runtime fast path

question: Should an exact `omitAuth=true`, credential-free web-search provider/plugin pairing be trusted to bypass full secrets preparation at startup?
rationale: This changes a deliberately conservative startup classification at the secrets boundary; source tests can prove the predicate but cannot determine the maintainers' accepted trust contract for plugin-owned keyless proxy configurations.

options.title: Approve narrow keyless exemption
options.body: Allow only an exact provider/plugin match with `omitAuth=true` and no credential, fetch, legacy, custom-load, deny, or extra-plugin surfaces, after live startup proof.

options.title: Keep full preparation
options.body: Continue treating every configured web-search surface as secrets-relevant, accepting the startup cost to preserve the current conservative boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow keyless exemption
recommendation.body: Allow only an exact provider/plugin match with `omitAuth=true` and no credential, fetch, legacy, custom-load, deny, or extra-plugin surfaces, after live startup proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant eager snapshot and inspect-versus-strict contracts appear to originate from and remain recently maintained by @joshavant.
